[[Acuity Lakefront]] }} '''Stopping Sableye''' (Japanese: '''VS ヤミラミ''' ''VS Sableye''), titled '''VS Sableye''' in the [[Chuang Yi]] translation, is the 395th chapter of the [[Pokémon Adventures]] manga, and the 58th chapter of the {{MangaArc|Diamond & Pearl}}. It is subtitled '''Lake Acuity and Jupiter''' (Japanese: '''エイチ湖とジュピター''' ''Eichi Lake and Jupiter'') in the [[VIZ Media]] translation and '''Lake Acuity and Jupiter''' in the Chuang Yi translation. ==Plot== {{spoilers}} In the [[Team Galactic HQ]], [[Charon]] talks about the importance of the [[Red Chain]], which controls {{p|Dialga}} and {{p|Palkia}}. He hopes that the capture of the {{p|Uxie|knowledge}}, {{p|Mesprit|emotion}}, and {{p|Azelf|willpower}} Pokémon will become a success to create the Red Chain. Meanwhile, {{adv|Diamond}} has arrived in [[Twinleaf Town]]. He heads to his house, with [[Roseanne]] and {{adv|Sebastian}} following him. When he enteres, he remembers his [[Johanna|mother]]'s happy reaction to his prize trip to [[Mt. Coronet]]. Diamond goes into his room and finds a new jacket along with a note that his mother left him. He puts on the jacket and reads the note. According to the note, his mother was at [[Lake Verity]], a great lake where [[Team Galactic]] will drop its bomb and capture one of the Lake Guardians. Shocked, Diamond throws off his jacket and rushes out the door, in a hurry to warn his mother about the upcoming disaster. Meanwhile, {{adv|Platinum}}, [[Maylene]], and [[Candice]] travel across the snowy mountains in order to reach [[Lake Acuity]]. Candice calls out her {{p|Abomasnow}} and has it to use {{m|Rock Climb}} to help them get over a mountain. Platinum talks about the time when her [[Mr. Berlitz|father]] said she went to the lake when she was little. The three of them arrive at Lake Acuity shortly afterwards. Suddenly, a {{p|Sableye}} appears and attacks Maylene's {{p|Riolu}} with {{m|Shadow Sneak}}. Then a {{p|Gastrodon}} comes up and traps Candice in a {{m|Mud Bomb}}. Candice realizes that the two Pokémon are actually trained and not from the wild. Then [[Jupiter]] reveals herself as the trainer of the Sableye and the Gastrodon. ==Major events== * {{adv|Diamond}} arrives home and changes his clothes before learning [[Johanna|his mother]] has been kidnapped and runs off to save her. * {{adv|Platinum}}, [[Maylene]], and [[Candice]] are attacked by [[Jupiter]]. {{Adventuresevents}} {{endspoilers}} ===Debuts=== * [[Jupiter]] * [[Charon]] ====Pokémon debuts==== * {{p|Gastrodon}} ({{form|Gastrodon|West Sea}}) * {{p|Uxie}} ==Characters== ===Humans=== * {{adv|Diamond}} * {{adv|Pearl}} (flashback) * {{adv|Platinum}} * [[Professor Rowan]] (flashback) * [[Maylene]] * [[Byron]] (flashback) * [[Candice]] * [[Jupiter]] * [[Charon]] * [[Advanced level Grunt]] * [[Johanna]] (flashback) * {{adv|Sebastian}} * [[Mr. Berlitz]] (flashback) * [[Roseanne]] ===Pokémon=== * {{p|Munchlax}} ({{adv|Lax}};
